durable_one_write_guard: Before the trusted Save click, the runner syncs the repository directory after creating test-results, exclusively creates and syncs the 0600 checkpoint file, then syncs test-results so its new directory entry survives a crash. The later response-ID update writes and syncs a temporary file, renames it over the checkpoint, then syncs test-results. A rerun with an ID skips Save; a checkpoint without an ID refuses another Save.
